title: A shopping centre instead of a park?
situation: You are spending a school year in a town in England, staying with a host family. You have read the notice below in the local newspaper. Write a formal e-mail to the Planning Department in which you give your views on the plan.
situationHu: Egy angol városban töltesz egy tanévet; az önkormányzat bevásárlóközpontot építene a város legnagyobb parkjának helyére. Írj hivatalos e-mailt a véleményedről.
stimulus:
PUBLIC CONSULTATION
The Town Council is planning to build a large shopping centre with a 500-space car park on the site of Willow Park, the largest green area in the town centre.
Residents are invited to send their views to the Planning Department by 30 November.

points.text: explain what the park means to local people, including young people
discuss the possible benefits of the new shopping centre
point out the environmental and other problems the plan could cause
suggest an alternative solution and say why it would be better

usefulPhrases.en: I am writing with regard to the proposed shopping centre in Willow Park.
usefulPhrases.hu: A Willow Parkba tervezett bevásárlóközponttal kapcsolatban írok.

usefulPhrases.en: Although I am only a temporary resident, …
It would undoubtedly create jobs and attract visitors.
usefulPhrases.hu: Kétségtelenül munkahelyeket teremtene és látogatókat vonzana.

usefulPhrases.en: On the other hand, it would lead to heavier traffic and more air pollution.
usefulPhrases.hu: Másrészt nagyobb forgalomhoz és erősebb légszennyezéshez vezetne.

usefulPhrases.en: I would strongly urge the Council to reconsider the plan.
usefulPhrases.hu: Nyomatékosan kérem a Tanácsot, hogy gondolja újra a tervet.

usefulPhrases.en: A better option might be to …
I trust that you will take residents' views into account.
usefulPhrases.hu: Bízom benne, hogy figyelembe veszik a lakosok véleményét.
Tisztelettel: (ha nem tudod a címzett nevét)
